title: Supplementary material, data and analysis programs for "UTC Timestamping of a Free-Running Delta–Sigma ADC With Evaluated Uncertainty: Method and Validation on the ozmV Synchrophasor Instrument"
description: Supplementary material (sections S-I to S-VII), the data behind every figure and table, and the analysis programs of the manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (2026). The manuscript treats the sampling instant of a free-running delta-sigma ADC as a measurand, evaluates the uncertainty of the UTC timestamp of each sample according to the GUM, measures the delays of the ADC and of the analog front end with the GNSS pulse and with PPS-triggered reference digitizers, and verifies the holdover through GNSS outages with a second prototype.
